scenes.prompt: Little Shri Krishna with a peacock feather crown and blue skin, calm gentle smile, lifting the green Govardhan hill on the little finger of his left hand, villagers of Gokul and white cows safely sheltered beneath it, soft rain outside and golden light inside, peaceful devotional mood

scenes.prompt: An Annakoot offering: a small mountain of many traditional sweets and dishes arranged in front of a decorated Shri Krishna altar with marigold flowers and lit clay diyas, festive temple courtyard, warm golden light

scenes.tts: अन्नकूट के पावन दिन आपका घर सदा भरा पूरा रहे।

scenes.prompt: Peaceful green Govardhan hill at sunrise with grazing white cows decorated with garlands, a small shrine with lit diyas at its foot, golden morning light, Braj countryside
